product_constraint: Exact target state/logits/output and configured drafts2/3; 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode with joint phase metrics
composition: 208 immutable canonical FP8 norm views prepared at transaction construction; one failure-safe owned allocation for norms plus16MiB serialized request scratch. Exact original repair for every uncertified element. Target NVFP4, draft, Attention/GDN, Prefill arithmetic and prefix commit unchanged.

arithmetic_review.domain: Finite E4M3 and BF16 activations zero or abs in[2^-32,128], positive scale[2^-32,2^32]. Products exact in FP32; nonzero lattice no finer than2^-41, so products and finite sums avoid FP32 underflow. Max5120/6144 term sums and scaled values avoid overflow. Unsafe inputs force repair.
arithmetic_review.rounding_model: At-least-FP32 K16 accumulation with unspecified order/rounding is conservatively bounded by16 one-ulp rounding steps, gamma32 at u=2^-24. Any binary addition order has at most16 nodes on a term path. Three K128 RN tree levels, six final tree levels and one scale multiply give<=42; gamma64 is conservative. This is a target instruction precision model, not an assertion of RN Tensor Core order.
arithmetic_review.scalar: Original 5/6 FMA chains, two within-thread merge levels, five warp levels, three block levels and scale: k/1024+11. Zero additions are exact.
arithmetic_review.norms: Every square, accumulation, tree merge, square root, norm product and error-radius operation rounds upward. Cauchy-Schwarz upper-bounds sum(abs(products)). Triangle bound covers original and fast paths. Strict outward interval containment in adjacent BF16 midpoint cell proves same final bits for certified normal finite output. Invalid/ambiguous/exceptional values use original scalar path.
arithmetic_review.scope: Candidate admission argument plus complete numerical comparisons; does not alone grant release authority.
